On Fri, 23 Oct 2026 18:52:05 -0700, Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> wrote:

> Hi Illustrarch team,
>
> (Writing to the Illustrarch newsroom directly — this is meant for
> whichever desk is closest to the topic below. Feel free to forward as
> appropriate.)
>
> Really enjoyed your explainer on minimalist architecture. Framing
> Ando's exposed concrete, water, and framed daylight as the archetype
> gets at why the style endures.
>
> A quick hello from our side: at My Villa, we bring European
> construction resilience and the Italian way of living to homes in Los
> Angeles, designed in exposed reinforced concrete, cemento a vista.
>
> One thought your piece sparked: that same discipline of light,
> proportion, and honest concrete is what we are bringing to Los
> Angeles, where European construction has paired resilience with
> restraint as default for generations. How minimalism reads as a way of
> living, not just a look, feels like the real story.
>
> Would you be interested in receiving more material on what we are
> doing, or in a short call with our founder Paolo?
>
> Best,
> Lisa Monelli
> My Villa Media Team
> info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
